description: Example only, not installed. Render real paths with jarvis/cli/claude_statusline_usage.py --workspace <workspace> --render-config, review, and add statusLine to the Claude Code settings only with the user's approval. Stores the 5-hour and weekly usage numbers only (.jarvis-dispatch/usage/claude-code.json); transcript_path, cwd and other input are ignored. Data appears only for claude.ai Pro and Max after the first response in a session.
